originalTitle: Crypto worth billions frozen after suspected Binance hack
summary: The firm has not said how much was potentially stolen but some crypto experts have put the figure at over $5bn.
content:
Binance is the world's biggest cryptocurrency trading platform

Cryptocurrency giant Binance said on Thursday that it has frozen digital assets worth around $3bn (£2.24bn) to prevent them from being stolen while it investigates a security issue.

The company said as part of a series of alerts online that all deposits and withdrawals are temporarily suspended while its teams conduct security checks and that the firm will "cover all losses".

Two other major crypto platforms, Tether and Circle, said they have also frozen a total of about $2.4bn of assets in response to the potential Binance hack.

Binance has not said how much was potentially stolen but some crypto experts have put the figure at over $5bn.

The security incident concerns Binance.com, while much smaller crypto platform Binance.US which provides trading services specifically for American residents, said its platform is not affected by the issue.

"It does look like a hack," Binance's former boss Changpeng Zhao said on X.

Zhao, who is also known as CZ, no longer manages the firm but remains a key shareholder.

Glassnode, a digital asset advisory firm, estimated the hack concerns a total of $5.3bn in crypto.

Meanwhile, New York-based blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis estimated that more than $5.9bn has been stolen.

That amount is nearly four times the value of crypto stolen from Dubai-based crypto exchange Bybit in 2025 - a record-breaking incident that has been attributed to hackers linked to North Korea.

Binance said the amount of funds frozen may continue to increase as its teams work closely with law enforcement and other partners to trace and seize additional assets.

"We are working around the clock and will share a full post-mortem once the investigation is complete. Please rely only on official Binance channels for updates," the firm said, adding that users' funds are safe.

Binance is the world's largest crypto exchange by daily trading volumes.

Bitcoin dropped by around 5% following the alerts. The price of other major cryptocurrencies including Ethereum and Solana also fell sharply.

Binance's former boss Changpeng Zhao, who is also known as CZ, said the incident looked like hack

Circle chief executive Jeremy Allaire said his firm is "closely tracking reports of a potential exploit involving Binance" and that his company has frozen more than $800m in assets linked to the incident.

Circle is the issuer and co-creator of the USDC, one of the world's largest US dollar-backed cryptocurrencies.

Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino said his firm has frozen around $1.6bn "related to a potential Binance exchange hack."

"Protecting the industry and our partners is our main priority," said Ardoino, whose company issues a cryptocurrency known as USDT.

Several crypto industry observers had flagged concerns about a potential hack on Binance hours before the exchange confirmed the security issue.

Binance, which was founded in China by Zhao in 2017, allows users to trade digital assets and is estimated to have more than 300 million registered users worldwide.

The exchange has been subject of regulatory scrutiny around the world.

The company said in 2024 that it has more than $160bn in assets under custody.

chineseTitle: 疑似币安遭到黑客攻击后价值数十亿美元的加密货币被冻结
chineseSummary: 该公司尚未透露可能被盗的金额，但一些加密货币专家估计这一数字超过 50 亿美元。
chineseContent:
币安是全球最大的加密货币交易平台

加密货币巨头币安周四表示，它已冻结了价值约 30 亿美元（22.4 亿英镑）的数字资产，以防止它们在调查安全问题时被盗。

该公司表示，作为一系列在线警报的一部分，在其团队进行安全检查期间，所有存款和取款都将暂停，该公司将“承担所有损失”。

另外两个主要加密平台 Tether 和 Circle 表示，为了应对币安可能遭受的黑客攻击，他们还冻结了总计约 24 亿美元的资产。

币安并未透露可能被盗的金额，但一些加密货币专家估计这一数字超过 50 亿美元。

此次安全事件涉及 Binance.com，而专门为美国居民提供交易服务的小型加密货币平台 Binance.US 表示，其平台并未受到该问题的影响。

币安前任老板赵长鹏在 X 上表示：“这看起来确实像是黑客攻击。”

赵（又名 CZ）不再管理该公司，但仍是主要股东。

数字资产咨询公司 Glassnode 估计，此次黑客攻击涉及的加密货币价值总计 53 亿美元。

与此同时，总部位于纽约的区块链分析公司 Chainaanalysis 估计，超过 59 亿美元的资金被盗。

这一数额几乎是 2025 年从迪拜加密货币交易所 Bybit 窃取的加密货币价值的四倍——这一破纪录的事件被认为是与朝鲜有关的黑客所为。

币安表示，随着其团队与执法部门和其他合作伙伴密切合作追踪和扣押更多资产，冻结的资金数额可能会继续增加。

该公司表示：“我们正在全天候工作，一旦调查完成，我们将分享完整的事后分析。请仅依赖币安官方渠道获取最新信息。”并补充说，用户的资金是安全的。

按日交易量计算，币安是全球最大的加密货币交易所。

警报发出后，比特币下跌了约 5%。包括以太坊和Solana在内的其他主要加密货币的价格也大幅下跌。

币安前任老板赵长鹏（又名 CZ）表示，这起事件看起来像是黑客攻击

Circle 首席执行官杰里米·阿莱尔 (Jeremy Allaire) 表示，他的公司正在“密切跟踪涉及币安的潜在漏洞的报告”，并且他的公司已冻结与该事件相关的超过 8 亿美元的资产。

Circle 是 USDC 的发行者和共同创建者，USDC 是世界上最大的美元支持的加密货币之一。

Tether 首席执行官 Paolo Ardoino 表示，他的公司已冻结约 16 亿美元，“与潜在的币安交易所黑客攻击有关”。

“保护行业和我们的合作伙伴是我们的首要任务，”Ardoino 说，他的公司发行了一种名为 USDT 的加密货币。

在币安确认安全问题前几个小时，几位加密货币行业观察人士就表达了对币安可能遭受黑客攻击的担忧。

币安由赵于 2017 年在中国创立，允许用户交易数字资产，估计在全球拥有超过 3 亿注册用户。

该交易所一直受到世界各地监管机构的审查。

该公司在 2024 年表示，其托管资产超过 1600 亿美元。
